Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 07-Feb-2025 (01:00 PM - 04:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.Tech. (CSE STREAM) EXAMINATIONS - FEBRUARY 2025  
  SUBJECT: CHM_1072 - APPLIED CHEMISTRY FOR ENGINEERS  
  (MAKEUP)  
  Applied Chemistry for Engineers [CHM-1072]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                       Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               Explain the construction and working of methanol fuel cells with appropriate reactions with a             (4)  
  diagram. Mention any two advantages of it.  
1B)               What are the special properties of lithium that make it advantageous to use as electrode material?        (4)  
  Write the electrode reactions that occur in the Li-C o O2 cell. What is the significance of electrolyte  
  additives in sodium-ion battery?  
1C)               Write two advantages and two disadvantages of nickel metal hydride batteries.                             (2)  
2A)               i) Distinguish between PVD and CVD process (any two).                                                     (4)  
  ii) Give reason: polyvinyl chloride (PVC) has higher tensile strength than Polyethylene.  
  iii) Calculate the number average and weight average molecular weight of a polymer sample in  
  which 30% of molecules have a molecular mass of 4000, 40% have a molecular mass of 6000 and  
  rest 30% have a molecular mass of 9000.  
2B)               i) Explain the mechanism of conductivity in extrinsic conducting polymers.                                (4)  
  ii) Give a detailed synthetic route with structure for the preparation of polyamides.  
  iii) Describe any two differences between types of filtration membranes.  
2C)               Explain the role of components present in MicroLED's.                                                     (2)  
3A)               Differentiate between the following                                                                       (4)  
  i) Diamagnetic vs Ferromagnetic material  
  ii) Intrinsic vs extrinsic semiconductors  
  iii) Electrical Conductors vs insulators  
  iv) Photo-conductivity vs luminescence  
3B)               Write a note on the following                                                                             (4)  
  i) Gas sensors  
  ii) Electrochemical sensor  
3C)               Give an account of factors affecting the resistivity of metals.                                           (2)  
4A)               i) Describe the environmental impact of improper e-waste disposal.                                        (4)  
  ii) What is the difference between linear economy and circular economy  
4B)               i) Explain the role of modular design and refurbishment of electronic devices in the context of the       (4)  
  circular economy approach.  
  ii) Name two health impacts of dioxins and furans released from e-waste.  
4C)               Differentiate between the following:                                                                      (2)  
  i) Primary and secondary batteries  
  ii) Fuel and galvanic cells  
5A)               Compare and contrast the plasticity and crystallinity of linear, branched, and cross-linked polymers. (4)  
  Calculate the intrinsic viscosity (dL/g) of a given polymer solution if its molecular weight is 100,000

$$g/mol, K=0.004, and a= 0.5, at room temperature.$$  
5B)   i) What are epoxies, and how do their chemical structures contribute to their desirable properties?   (4)  
  ii) Write any four advantages of polylactic acid as a biodegradable polymer  
5C)   How is the pKa value of a weak acid determined graphically in the potentiometric titration of a weak (2)  
  acid with a strong base? Explain based on Henderson's equation.
